episodeTitle.en: How to get press for your product | Jason Feifer (editor in chief of Entrepreneur magazine)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何为你的产品获取媒体关注 | 杰森·费弗（Jason Feifer，《创业家》杂志主编）

guestBioOfficial.en: Jason Feifer is the editor in chief of Entrepreneur magazine and a former editor at Fast Company. He’s also a podcast host, book author, keynote speaker, and startup advisor. Every week, he shares tips in his newsletter, One Thing Better, to help people become happier and more effective at work. In today’s episode, Jason draws upon his wealth of experience in media to share tactical insights on how to get press coverage. We discuss: • High-level steps to securing press coverage for your product
guestBioOfficial.zh: 杰森·费弗是《创业家》杂志的主编，也是《快公司》的前编辑。他还是播客主持人、书籍作者、主题演讲者和创业顾问。每周，他都会在自己的时事通讯《One Thing Better》中分享小贴士，帮助人们在工作中变得更快乐、更高效。在今天的节目中，杰森凭借其丰富的媒体经验，分享了如何获得媒体报道的实用见解。我们讨论了： • 确保产品获得媒体报道的高级步骤

title.en: How to get press for your product | Jason Feifer (editor in chief of Entrepreneur magazine)
title.zh: 如何为你的产品获取媒体关注 | 杰森·费弗（Jason Feifer，《创业家》杂志主编）

summary.en: Jason reframes the journalist's mindset: editors and writers don't care about you, they care about their audience—so pitch how you can help them serve readers, not as a service provider. He covers how to find and pitch the right journalist (freelancers are often more responsive), why a publication's mission must shape your pitch, which channels to use to reach out, and how to define what success from press actually looks like. It's a pragmatic, no-nonsense guide to getting coverage for your product.
summary.zh: Jason 重新框定了记者的心态：编辑和记者不在乎你，他们在乎的是读者——所以你的 pitch 要说明你能如何帮他们服务读者，而不是把他们当服务商。他讲了如何找到并对正确的记者出手（自由撰稿人往往更积极）、为何媒体的使命必须塑造你的 pitch、用哪些渠道去联系，以及如何定义“拿到曝光”真正的成功标准。这期节目是关于为产品争取报道的务实、去水分的指南。
